lines.en: label harukadate10:
scene harukarinreview1
I show up at the cafe to find Haruka and Rin sitting at a table near the door.
lines.zh: 我到咖啡馆的时候，Haruka 和 Rin 正坐在靠门的一张桌子旁。

lines.en: The girl manning the counter is someone I haven’t seen before so, not wanting to involve myself with anyone new, I decide to intrude on the conversation between these two.
lines.zh: 柜台后面站着的是个我没见过的女孩，我不想再跟什么新面孔扯上关系，于是决定去打扰她们俩的谈话。

lines.en: Judging by the clipboard, however, it appears that I may have suddenly walked into a relatively important discussion.
lines.zh: 不过看那块写字板，我好像一脚踩进了一场相当重要的谈话。

lines.en: Whoops.
lines.zh: 哦豁。

lines.en: : Hey! Is it Sensei-time already?
lines.zh: : 嘿！已经到“老师时间”了吗？

lines.en: : Yes, it appears it is Sensei-time.
lines.zh: : 是啊，看来确实是“老师时间”。

lines.en: : Sensei-time isn’t a thing. Please don’t say that anymore.
lines.zh: : 根本没有“老师时间”这种东西。别再这么说了。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview2
: Sensei-time.
lines.zh: : 老师时间。

lines.en: : Anyway, what are you two doing over here? Shouldn’t you be working right now?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你们俩在这儿干什么？现在不是该干活吗？

lines.en: scene harukarinreview3
: I was actually just doing Rin’s performance review for the quarter.
lines.zh: : 我其实是在给 Rin 做这个季度的绩效考核。

lines.en: : Yup-yup. And, news-flash, turns out I’m pretty awesome. Who would have thought?
lines.zh: : 对对。插播一条新闻——结果证明我超厉害的。谁能想到呢？

lines.en: : Not me considering you have only given me what I’ve actually ordered maybe once or twice since I started coming here.
lines.zh: : 我可没想到。毕竟从我光顾这儿以来，你真正端上我点的东西，大概也就一两次。

lines.en: : That’s just cause you’re special. Tell him, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你特别啊。你跟他说，Haruka。

lines.en: : This is news to me, actually. I’m going to dock a few points from your review so I don’t have to give you a raise.
lines.zh: : 这我倒是头一回听说。看来我得从你的考核里扣几分，这样就不用给你加薪了。

lines.en: : Please do better in the future for the sake of the company.
lines.zh: : 为了公司，以后请好好表现。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview4
: Are you bein’ for real right now?
lines.zh: : 你认真的吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. You can keep making whatever you want for him as long as he continues to keep doing nothing about it.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。只要他继续就这么放任不管，你想给他做什么就做什么。

lines.en: : Wow, the service here has really gone downhill lately.
lines.zh: : 哇，这儿的服务水平最近真是江河日下啊。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview5
: Like Rin said, you’re special.
lines.zh: : 就像 Rin 说的，你特别嘛。

lines.en: : Plus, we’re friends now.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我们现在是朋友了。

lines.en: : I don’t have to be nice to you anymore now that I know you’re here for the girls instead of the coffee.
lines.zh: : 既然我知道你来这儿是为了那些女孩而不是咖啡，我就没必要再对你客套了。

lines.en: : Hey wait a second, how come you two are acting super close all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 诶等等，你们俩怎么突然这么亲密了？

lines.en: : When did this happen?
lines.zh: : 这是什么时候的事？

lines.en: : In my defense, I am not acting any different than normal. This is all Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我得为自己辩解一句，我的态度跟平时没什么两样。全是 Haruka 的问题。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview6
: There’s no need to be jealous, Rin. I’m sure you still see him more often than I do.
lines.zh: : 用不着嫉妒啦，Rin。你见他的次数肯定还是比我多。

lines.en: : Well...probably.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概吧。

lines.en: : And I’m not jealous. I’m just surprised.
lines.zh: : 而且我没嫉妒。我只是有点吃惊。

lines.en: : I could have sworn you were a loner, Haruka. I didn’t even know you talked to anybody other than all of us at the cafe.
lines.zh: : 我还一直以为你是个独来独往的人呢，Haruka。我甚至不知道你除了我们咖啡馆这些人之外，还会跟别人说话。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview7
: Oh. Well thank you for reminding me of how incredibly lonely I am, Rin. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 哦。那还真是谢谢你提醒我有多么孤独啊，Rin。感激不尽。

lines.en: : No sweat! This is just our thing, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不客气！这就是我们之间的相处方式嘛，对吧？

lines.en: : You tease me about not being able to reach the syrup bottles on the top shelf and I tease you about going years without getting laid.
lines.zh: : 你拿我够不到顶层糖浆瓶的事开涮，我就拿你几年没做过爱的事回敬你。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
scene harukarinreview8
Don’t do it, Haruka.
lines.zh: 别开口，Haruka。

lines.en: Don’t say anything.
lines.zh: 什么都别说。

lines.en: : Hm? Isn’t this the part where you come up with some sarcastic remark or something?
lines.zh: : 嗯？这时候你不该来句挖苦话什么的吗？

lines.en: : We’re supposed to go back and forth right about now and-
lines.zh: : 我们现在应该来回斗嘴才对，而且——

lines.en: scene harukarinreview9
: Oh my God, you fucked my boss!
lines.zh: : 我的天，你把我老板睡了！

lines.en: : Dude!
lines.zh: : 不是吧老兄！

lines.en: : Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Don’t you think I would have told you if something like that happened, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你觉得真有那种事，我会不告诉你吗，Rin？

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
scene harukarinreview10
: No, actually. You kind of have a track record of going behind my back with people I know now, so yeah.
lines.zh: : 不，我还真不觉得。你背着我和我认识的人搞在一起，这事儿可是有前科的，所以嘛，对。

lines.en: : That’s...
I decide against prying anymore into that side of things at the risk of further-destroying my relationship with Rin.
lines.zh: 我决定不再往那个方向深挖了，免得把我跟 Rin 的关系进一步搞砸。

lines.en: else:
scene harukarinreview11
: Well, yeah. But Haruka really only gets quiet like this when she’s trying to hide something.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧。不过 Haruka 只有在想藏什么事的时候，才会这么安静。

lines.en: : Plus, I already told you she thought you were cute and stuff a while back, so it’s not impossible for something like that to happen.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我之前就跟你说过，她觉得你挺可爱的什么的，所以发生那种事也不是不可能。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview12
: I’m kind of surprised by Haruka, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我还挺意外 Haruka 的。

lines.en: : I know you haven’t seen your husband in a while but I didn’t think you’d crack under the pressure that-
lines.zh: : 我知道你很久没见到你丈夫了，但我没想到你会顶不住压力就——

lines.en: : I didn’t crack.
lines.zh: : 我没有顶不住。

lines.en: : Nothing is going on between your teacher and me.
lines.zh: : 我和你老师之间什么都没有。

lines.en: : I was just messing with you since I know you two are close.
lines.zh: : 我只是逗你玩而已，我知道你们俩关系好。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview13
: Well...
: That’s kind of a relief. But now I also feel really bad about accusing you of something like that.
lines.zh: : 这我就放心了。不过现在我也有点内疚，不该那样冤枉你。

lines.en: : You should probably get a little better at hiding things if you want to-
lines.zh: : 你要是还想——那你藏事的本事可得再练练。

lines.en: : Get back to work, Rin.
lines.zh: : 回去干活，Rin。

lines.en: : I was just leaving.
lines.zh: : 我正要走呢。

lines.en: : Sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview14
Rin quickly ducks away from the table, taking her notebook and coffee with her before disappearing into the back room.
lines.zh: Rin 迅速从桌边抽身，带上她的笔记本和咖啡，消失在了后面的房间里。

lines.en: else:
scene harukarinreview15
: Hey. You leave my sex-life out of this.
lines.zh: : 喂。别把我的性生活扯进来。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how satisfying it will actually be when he comes back from the war?
lines.zh: : 你知道等他从战场上回来的时候，会有多满足吗？

lines.en: : Nope. I’m an innocent virgin barista so I have no idea how satisfying it is in the first place.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我是个纯洁的处女咖啡师，所以压根不知道那有多满足。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview16
: Oh my God...Why am I even talking to you about this?
lines.zh: : 我的天……我到底为什么要跟你说这些？

lines.en: : Sensei, I’m sorry my boss doesn’t feel the same way about you as you feel about her.
lines.zh: : 老师，很遗憾我老板对你的感觉，跟你对她的感觉不一样。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Thankfully, the girl I’ve been after for literally years is, so you’ll have to settle for fucking a cute [teenager] instead of a voluptuous older woman.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，我追了整整好几年的那个女孩对我是一样的，所以你就只能将就着去睡个可爱的 [teenager]，而不是一个丰腴的成熟女人了。

lines.en: : Sorry for your loss.
lines.zh: : 节哀顺变。

lines.en: : Rin...
lines.zh: : Rin……

lines.en: else:
: There are plenty of other fish in the sea, though. I’m sure you’ll catch one eventually.
lines.zh: : 不过天涯何处无芳草嘛。我相信你总有一天会钓到一条的。

lines.en: : Heck, you might even have a shot with me if you keep trying. It only makes sense to fall for someone you keep spending time with, right?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你要是继续努力，说不定连我都有机会。喜欢上一个总跟你待在一起的人，这不是很合理吗？

lines.en: : Sure there’s the added issue of me still thinking penises are kind of scary, but you know how it is.
lines.zh: : 当然还有个小问题，就是我到现在还觉得那话儿挺吓人的，不过你也懂的。

lines.en: : I thought I did until that last part. Now I’m just back to being confused.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为我懂，直到你说了最后那句。现在我又糊涂了。

lines.en: : It is what it is, homie.
lines.zh: : 事情就是这样啦，老铁。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview17
: And on that note, our review is now complete.
lines.zh: : 既然话都说到这份上了，我们的考核到此结束。

lines.en: : Get back to work, Rin.
lines.zh: : 回去干活，Rin。

lines.en: : Aye aye, Captain Haruka!
lines.zh: : 遵命，Haruka 船长！

lines.en: : Have fun not having sex with my teacher!
lines.zh: : 祝你跟我老师“不做爱”愉快！

lines.en: : And you have fun cleaning the bathrooms. Leave.
lines.zh: : 那你就好好享受打扫厕所的乐趣吧。走吧。

lines.en: : Roger that! Love you, bye!
lines.zh: : 收到！爱你，拜！

lines.en: scene harukarinreview18
Rin quickly ducks away from the table, taking her notebook and coffee with her before disappearing into the back room.
lines.zh: Rin 迅速从桌边抽身，带上她的笔记本和咖啡，消失在了后面的房间里。

lines.en: : I have to commend you for being able to put up with her for this long every weekend.
lines.zh: : 我真得佩服你，每个周末都能忍受她这么久。

lines.en: : You have to put up with her too, don’t you? Isn’t she in your class?
lines.zh: : 你不也得忍受她吗？她不是你班上的学生吗？

lines.en: : She is, but she’s a little different in[school] than she is here.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过她在[school]里跟在这儿有点不一样。

lines.en: : She seems happier in the cafe. Kind of like she admires you or something like that.
lines.zh: : 她在咖啡馆里看起来更开心。有点像是她挺崇拜你的，或者类似的感觉。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview19
: Me? Why would she admire me?
lines.zh: : 我？她崇拜我什么？

lines.en: : All I do is work and talk about what shows I’ve been watching on Netflix lately.
lines.zh: : 我每天除了工作，就是聊最近在 Netflix 上看了什么剧。

lines.en: if harukalust10 == True:
: I’m kind of insanely boring if you take out the part about me dressing up as a cat and riding you on occasion.
lines.zh: : 要是把我偶尔穿成猫娘骑在你身上那段去掉，我这人简直无聊得要命。

lines.en: : But that’s my favorite part about you.
lines.zh: : 可我最喜欢的就是你那一点。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview20
: I still kind of can’t believe I was drunk enough to do something like that.
lines.zh: : 我现在还有点不敢相信，我当时得醉成什么样才做得出那种事。

lines.en: : Maki really manages to bring the worst out of me sometimes.
lines.zh: : Maki 有时候真的能把我最烂的一面给逼出来。

lines.en: : Was it Maki’s idea to invite me over?
lines.zh: : 叫我去你家，是 Maki 的主意吗？

lines.en: : Well, no. But-
lines.zh: : 嗯，不是。可是——

lines.en: : Then don’t blame her for what happened.
lines.zh: : 那就别为发生的事怪她。

lines.en: : You made a decision and you followed through with it. She just happened to be there for it.
lines.zh: : 是你自己做了决定，并且贯彻到底了。她只是刚好在场而已。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview21
: You’re right. I need to accept responsibility for my actions.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我得为自己的行为负责。

lines.en: : I’ve just gone so long without being...involved in someone new that I kind of forget how it works at times.
lines.zh: : 我只是……太久没有跟新的人有纠葛了，所以有时候会忘了这事儿是怎么运作的。

lines.en: : But, in my defense-
lines.zh: : 不过，替我自己说句公道话——

lines.en: : Maki is fucking hot.
lines.zh: : Maki 真的辣死了。

lines.en: : I can’t believe you made me wait an extra 24 hours to hook up with you two after the Halloween party at the bar.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信，酒吧那场万圣节派对之后，你让我多等了整整 24 小时才跟你俩搞上。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview22
: And I can’t believe you went upstairs with Sara without inviting the two of us.
lines.zh: : 我也不敢相信，你跟 Sara 上楼去了，居然没叫上我们俩。

lines.en: : Sara didn’t want you to come.
lines.zh: : Sara 不想让你们来。

lines.en: : I can’t believe you didn’t keep pushing for it to happen. Jerk.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你就这么放弃了，没再争取一下。混蛋。

lines.en: : Didn’t you pass out within the next 30 minutes anyway?
lines.zh: : 你不是反正半小时之内就昏过去了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Out of disappointment.
lines.zh: : 是啊。失望得昏过去了。

lines.en: : Poor Maki.
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Maki。

lines.en: : More like poor Haruka.
lines.zh: : 应该说可怜的 Haruka 才对。

lines.en: if saralust10 == True:
: Kind of degrading listening to your best friend get fucked by the guy you’re into while you sit downstairs and get drunk.
lines.zh: : 坐在楼下喝闷酒，听着自己最好的朋友被喜欢的人干，这感觉还挺屈辱的。

lines.en: : You heard us?
lines.zh: : 你听见了？

lines.en: I guess that makes sense given how old the building Sara lives in is.
lines.zh: 想想 Sara 住的那栋楼有多老，倒也说得通。

lines.en: That’s kind of concerning in the event of anyone else ever being downstairs while...things are happening, though.
lines.zh: 不过要是以后还有什么人刚好在楼下，而“事情”正在发生，那就有点麻烦了。

lines.en: : Of course I heard you. That girl is even louder than I am.
lines.zh: : 我当然听见了。那丫头叫得比我还大声。

lines.en: : Mmm...I don’t think that’s true.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我倒不觉得。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview23
: I’m louder than that?
lines.zh: : 我比她还大声？

lines.en: : Do you not realize how into it you get, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 你是没意识到自己投入起来有多疯吗，Haruka？

lines.en: : I had no idea...
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道……

lines.en: : My neighbors...Do you think they, you know, hear us?
lines.zh: : 我的邻居们……你觉得他们，嗯，听得见我们吗？

lines.en: : I’d be shocked if they didn’t, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，要是他们听不见，我反倒会觉得吃惊。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview24
: Oh God...
lines.zh: : 哦天哪……

lines.en: : Something wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : A lot is wrong. I don’t want to talk about it here, though.
lines.zh: : 不对劲的地方多了去了。不过我不想在这儿说。

lines.en: : Apparently I’m a walking megaphone so I don’t want the girls to hear us talking about how loud I am when you fuck me.
lines.zh: : 看来我就是个会走路的扩音器，我可不想让那些女孩听见我们在讨论，你干我的时候我叫得有多响。

lines.en: : Right.
lines.zh: : 也是。

lines.en: else:
: Maki might be super hot, but I don't really think she could please me the same you can.
lines.zh: : Maki 也许是辣得不行，但我不觉得她能像你一样让我满足。

lines.en: : If there is any woman who can do just that, I'm positive it's Maki. Have you seen the arsenal of sex toys at her shop?
lines.zh: : 如果有哪个女人能做到，我敢肯定就是 Maki。你见过她店里那一整柜子的情趣玩具吗？

lines.en: else:
: You’re right. That does sound incredibly lonely.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。那听起来确实孤独得离谱。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview25
: It’s even lonelier when I eat an entire pint of ice cream and cry myself to sleep afterward.
lines.zh: : 更孤独的是，我一个人吃掉一整品脱冰淇淋，然后哭着睡着。

lines.en: : Such is the life of a woman who lives alone.
lines.zh: : 独居女人的生活就是这样的。

lines.en: : Sara lives alone and I doubt she cries herself to sleep every night.
lines.zh: : Sara 也是一个人住，我可不觉得她每晚都哭着睡着。

lines.en: : Yes but Sara also keeps a dildo on the shelf next to her bed so she is clearly a force to be reckoned with.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，可 Sara 床头柜上就摆着一根假阳具，所以她显然是个不容小觑的狠角色。

lines.en: : Yeah, good point.
lines.zh: : 嗯，有道理。

lines.en: : But anyway, I do think Rin sees you as some sort of role model. At least that’s how I’d see you in her position.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我确实觉得 Rin 把你当成某种榜样。至少我要是处在她的位置，会这么看你。

lines.en: : People like looking up to more successful people in the same position as them.
lines.zh: : 人总是喜欢仰视那些和自己处境相同、却更成功的人。

lines.en: : And even if you’re lonely, you’re still doing something with your life.
lines.zh: : 而且就算你孤独，你也依然在用自己的生活做点什么。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview26
: Did you really come here just to lecture me?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是专程来教育我的吧？

lines.en: : No. I came here to see you. So this is supposed to be the part where you start feeling a little less lonely.
lines.zh: : 不是。我是来看你的。所以按理说，现在该是你觉得没那么孤独的时候了。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview27
: You’re here to see me despite having a girl like, half my age and four times prettier than me two steps away from just...biting the bullet and admitting her love for you?
lines.zh: : 明明有个年纪只有我一半、漂亮四倍的女孩，就差一步就要咬牙向你表白了，你却跑来看我？

lines.en: : Rin doesn’t love me, Haruka.
lines.zh: : Rin 不爱我，Haruka。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview28
if rinbetrayed == True:
: Oh please. She looks at you differently than pretty much every other guy that’s ever come in here.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。她看你的眼神，跟所有来过这儿的男人都不一样。

lines.en: : She swings both ways, doesn’t she? I’m sure she’d be more than willing to embark on a journey of sexual exploration with you under the right circumstances.
lines.zh: : 她男女通吃，不是吗？我敢肯定，只要条件合适，她会很乐意跟你展开一场性探索之旅的。

lines.en: : It would be easier for me to believe that if I didn’t finger the girl she’s in love with.
lines.zh: : 如果我没用手碰过她暗恋的那个女孩，这话我可能更容易相信。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview29
: You fingered the cute blonde girl who comes in here all the time?!
lines.zh: : 你用手碰了那个经常来这儿的可爱金发女孩？！

lines.en: : No. You never heard that.
lines.zh: : 没有。你什么都没听见。

lines.en: : No! I did totally just hear that!
lines.zh: : 不！我完完全全听见了！

lines.en: : How did that even happen?!
lines.zh: : 这到底是怎么发生的？！

lines.en: else:
: Oh, please. Ever since the blonde girl rejected her, she’s only ever really talked about you.
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托。自从那个金发女孩拒绝她之后，她就只念叨你一个人了。

lines.en: : Probably just a coincidence. I doubt Rin sees me as anything more than like, an older brother or father figure right now.
lines.zh: : 大概只是巧合。我怀疑 Rin 现在看我，顶多也就是个哥哥或者父亲之类的角色。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview30
: Doesn’t mean she doesn’t want to try experimenting a little bit, though~
lines.zh: : 但这不代表她不想试着体验一下嘛~

lines.en: : She’s a [teenage]girl. She’s curious. I was the same when I was her age.
lines.zh: : 她是个 [teenage]女孩。她好奇。我在她那个年纪也一样。

lines.en: : You really think she’s never entertained the thought of fooling around with the same guy who hangs out with her in her room all the time?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得，她从来没动过念头，想跟那个总在她房间里陪她的男人搞点什么吗？

lines.en: : Come on, man. You know better than that.
lines.zh: : 得了吧老兄。你心里清楚得很。

lines.en: : You’ve put a lot of thought into this, huh?
lines.zh: : 你在这上面花了不少心思啊？

lines.en: : When you’ve got employees as cute as her, you sometimes can’t help but think about things like that.
lines.zh: : 手底下有这么可爱的员工，有时候就难免会想些这种事。

lines.en: : I’m starting to think you might be just as into [teenage]girls as me, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，你对 [teenage]女孩的兴趣可能跟我一样大了，Haruka。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview31
: Me? Nooooo.
lines.zh: : 我？才没有呢~

lines.en: : I just staff my cafe with inexperienced, cute girls because they make the best employees.
lines.zh: : 我只是专门雇些没经验的可爱女孩，因为她们是最好的员工。

lines.en: : Of course I’m into them. Everyone loves cute girls, Sensei. Just because I’m a girl doesn’t mean I’m an exception to that.
lines.zh: : 我当然喜欢她们。谁不喜欢可爱女孩啊，老师。就因为我自己是女的，也不代表我能例外。

lines.en: : I mean, I’m all about this. But you should probably be careful acting on anything at the risk of getting sued one day.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我完全支持。不过你要真付诸行动，最好还是小心点，免得哪天被起诉。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview32
: Oh, come on. I’m a degenerate but I’m not a bad person.
lines.zh: : 哦得了吧。我是个堕落的人，但我不是坏人。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
She says, despite actively cheating on her husband.
lines.zh: 她这么说，尽管她此刻正在给丈夫戴绿帽。

lines.en: : It’s one thing for me to be attracted to girls like Rin or Molly-
lines.zh: : 我被 Rin 或 Molly 这样的女孩吸引，是一回事——

lines.en: : Molly, too?
lines.zh: : Molly 也算？

lines.en: scene harukarinreview33
: Or Rin’s friend Futaba.
lines.zh: : 或者 Rin 的朋友 Futaba。

lines.en: : Or Molly’s friend...Tsuneyo, I think?
lines.zh: : 或者 Molly 的朋友……Tsuneyo，我记得是叫这个？

lines.en: Oh my God. She’s just as bad as me.
lines.zh: 我的天。她跟我一样烂。

lines.en: : But just wanting to mess around with all of them doesn’t mean I actually would, you know?
lines.zh: : 但光是想跟她们乱来，不代表我真会去做，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Unless they offered. Because in that case, I absolutely would.
lines.zh: : 除非她们主动送上门。因为那样的话，我是绝对会做的。

lines.en: : I’m glad we became friends, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴我们成了朋友，Haruka。

lines.en: : I feel like our relationship has moved forward several steps today.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们今天的关系往前迈了好几步。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview34
: Then come hang out with me again soon. As friends.
lines.zh: : 那改天再来陪陪我吧。以朋友的身份。

lines.en: : We’ll sit on my couch and I can show you some of the stuff I watch when I’m thinking about how lonely I am.
lines.zh: : 我们坐在我家沙发上，我可以给你看看，我在胡思乱想自己有多孤独的时候会看些什么。

lines.en: : That sounds absolutely delightful.
lines.zh: : 听起来真是太棒了。

lines.en: Not.
lines.zh: 才怪。

lines.en: scene harukarinreview35
: Sweet. Maybe I’ll invite Rin, too? Who knows?
lines.zh: : 好极了。说不定我也会叫上 Rin？谁知道呢？

lines.en: : You’re going to invite a [teenage]girl to your house to watch movies with you and another older guy?
lines.zh: : 你要请一个 [teenage]女孩来你家，跟你们俩——你和一个年纪更大的男人——一起看电影？

lines.en: : Totally not suspicious at all.
lines.zh: : 完全没有可疑之处。

lines.en: : And hanging out in her dorm isn’t?
lines.zh: : 那在她宿舍里混就没问题了？

lines.en: : Touché.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。

lines.en: : Oh well. Do whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 行吧。你想怎么做都行。

lines.en: : If I do whatever I want, I’ll end up in jail.
lines.zh: : 我要是真想怎么做就怎么做，早晚得进监狱。

lines.en: : I will exercise the same amount of restraint I always do, and the two of us will forget this conversation ever happened.
lines.zh: : 我会拿出跟往常一样的自制力，然后我们俩就当这场对话从未发生过。

lines.en: : Deal?
lines.zh: : 说定了？

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 说定了。

lines.en: No deal.
lines.zh: 没说定。

lines.en: I can’t just forget finding out that Haruka is lusting after her entire cafe staff and...everyone her cafe staff knows and...
lines.zh: 我不可能就这么忘了——Haruka 对她整家店的员工都心怀欲念，还有……员工认识的所有人，还有……

lines.en: Probably just everyone in general.
lines.zh: 大概就是所有人吧。

lines.en: But I guess after going years without having sex, you start getting desperate.
lines.zh: 不过我想，好几年没做过爱之后，人是会变得饥不择食的。

lines.en: To think Haruka would be permanently psychologically damaged by something like this, though...
lines.zh: 可一想到 Haruka 会因为这种事留下永久的心理创伤……

lines.en: That’s just so sad.
lines.zh: 真是太可悲了。

lines.en: : Well, I guess I’ll get out of your hair then.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我就不打扰你了。

lines.en: : Sounds good. I need to start actually working again anyway.
lines.zh: : 好啊。反正我也得开始干活了。

lines.en: : Call me soon, though. Got it?
lines.zh: : 不过记得尽快给我打电话。明白吗？

lines.en: : Yup.
: See you later, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Haruka。

lines.en: : Talk to you soon!
lines.zh: : 保持联系！

lines.en: scene black
I exit the cafe without buying anything.
lines.zh: 我什么都没买就走出了咖啡馆。

lines.en: Not because I wasn’t thirsty, but because I’d inadvertently gotten an erection after finding out about Haruka’s hidden infatuation with [teenage]girls and didn’t want to scare any of the part-timers.
lines.zh: 不是因为我不渴，而是得知 Haruka 偷偷迷恋 [teenage]女孩之后，我不小心起了反应，不想吓到那些兼职生。

lines.en: Eventually, the erection fades and I am free to get on with my day the way I normally do.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，那股劲头退了下去，我终于可以像往常一样继续我的一天。

lines.en: I’ll have to call Haruka some night in the near future and see if I can do anything else to quell that undying loneliness of hers.
lines.zh: 改天晚上我得给 Haruka 打个电话，看看还能不能做点什么，去平息她那份不死不休的孤独。
